# Frozen benchmark packages

These are immutable compatibility inputs, not outputs regenerated by tests.
Each archive contains a complete 33 x 33 package with PNG8, float32 TIFF,
configuration, manifest and CSV references. The table below is the canonical
inventory of archives, their coverage, producer commits and SHA-256 digests.

| Archive | Historical producer commit | Coverage | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| benchmark-v1.zip | 7069e7b3fa7a462d8889a49a6447fe91375ef1e1 | Static H6, two frames | 262397deadd4cb8fe3528ffde084f5df335da9f5639983d85e4ac8591194423d |
| benchmark-v2.zip | f9d736e1abf47625447d4aeccbe81919a18c0151 | H6 energy scan, common drift, dense/sparse schedules, five frames | 5ef1b63494d93428ed796eb6cefb88679ac85ff23d4682209090f04223e415f5 |
| benchmark-v3.zip | b12cc932109d77562fe2eb098e84b3c95e43fb6a | H54 energy scan, elliptical profiles, 216 independent masks, two frames | 21ff2bc6daf5c54f0188cfa649d508329fe70307dcf209207ff5fa0b6fc551c5 |

The v1 and v2 archives were captured once on 2026-10-06 from byte-exact source
snapshots of their producer commits, with Python 3.12.3, NumPy 2.2.5,
Pillow 11.2.1 and tifffile 2025.3.30.
The snapshots had no Git metadata, so their manifests correctly record null
Git revision/dirty values; the original source hashes and library versions
remain inside each manifest. The archives' fixed ZIP timestamps are packaging
metadata, not acquisition times.

The v3 archive was captured before stage 04 changes on 2026-10-07 from its
producer commit. The checkout also contained unrelated user changes, so its
recorded Git dirty flag is true. This additional archive does not replace or
regenerate earlier fixtures.

Do not overwrite these files or update their pinned test digests when changing
the generator. Add a separately named fixture for a new format version.
Tests extract copies to temporary directories and call the current public
reader. Missing, changed or unreadable historical packages must fail validation.
